payout_value_note: Flat $100 to the referrer per eligible referral; referred person also gets $100. Referrer capped at $400 per calendar year (4 referrals).
payout_quote: Existing Beacon Bank customers making a referral ('Referrer') will receive $100 for each eligible individual referred ... The initial Referrer may receive up to a maximum of $400 within a calendar year ... The Refer a Friend campaign is scheduled to end on December 31, 2026.
steps: Referrer logs into online banking/app and uses the Refer a Friend tile to get a personalized referral link.

Referrer sends the personalized link to the friend BEFORE account opening; the friend must use it and enter the referral code during the application (applications must be submitted by December 31, 2026).
Friend (new Beacon Bank customer) opens a Beacon One checking or Beacon One University checking account.
Friend's account must receive a combined direct deposit of $500+ per month for three consecutive months (first DD within 45 days of account opening).
Beacon Bank credits $100 to each party the calendar month after the third qualifying direct deposit; credit appears as 'Beacon One Refer-A-Friend Credit'.
catches: Referrer cap: maximum $400 in credits per calendar year (4 referrals).
Friend must receive $500+/month direct deposit for THREE consecutive months — the heaviest activity requirement in this wave.
Only Beacon One checking and Beacon One University checking qualify.
Referral link must be sent before account opening and the code entered at application; missing/wrong code means no credit for either party.
Credits may be reportable to the IRS on Form 1099-MISC.
Campaign ends December 31, 2026; program may be discontinued or changed at any time.
Referrer and referred person cannot be the same person or joint account holder.
biggest_catch: Capped at $400/year (4 referrals), and the friend must receive $500+/month in direct deposits for three straight months — payout takes 4+ months.
eligibility: Beacon Bank customers; friend must be a new Beacon Bank customer 18+.
timing: Link sharing ~5 min active; credits paid the calendar month after the third qualifying direct deposit (~4-5 months).
